outcome_impact: One wasted unattended launch (run 20261011T050436Z) that re-stopped at preflight_smoke for a different root cause; produced an extra STOPPED artifact and ~5 min of session time. No data written to sik (smoke is read-only); no source modified beyond run_all.sh.
what_went_wrong: I relaunched the unattended run_all.sh right after fixing the smoke gate, without first exercising the fixed smoke path manually. The relaunch failed at the same gate for a DIFFERENT reason: only openjdk-17-jre-headless was installed (no libawt_xawt.so) so the real Swing dialog threw HeadlessException even with Xvfb running.
root_cause: I validated the gate logic statically (read BilingHarness.java source) but did not run the actual failing step end-to-end before relaunching. On a freshly provisioned box, environment gaps (headless-only JRE) only surface at execution; the original AIOOBE had masked this deeper gap.
actual_damage: Extra launch + diagnosis cycle; STOPPED_AT_preflight_smoke.md for run 20261011T050436Z retained as evidence (diagnosis section filled).
remediation_done: Isolated via test matrix (Xvfb up, DISPLAY set, faketime env check, full harness run), installed openjdk-17-jre, then MANUALLY ran the exact smoke command to green (rc=0, tbBilling rows=13, sik.billing 6288 unchanged before/after) BEFORE relaunch 2 (run 20261011T050921Z), which passed Phase 0 and stopped at the expected Phase 1 gate.
remediation_recommended: Before any unattended relaunch after a fix: reproduce the previously failing step manually to green on the target box. A static code read is not runtime validation, especially on fresh infrastructure.
